name: ret_1d
intuition: Last-session momentum or reversal.
availability: FMP daily close provisionally assigned to 17:00 New York; historical bar boundary is unresolved.

name: ret_5d
intuition: Short trend in the currency quote.
availability: FMP daily close provisionally assigned to 17:00 New York; historical bar boundary is unresolved.

name: ret_20d
intuition: Medium trend in the currency quote.
availability: FMP daily close provisionally assigned to 17:00 New York; historical bar boundary is unresolved.

name: abs_ret_1d
intuition: Size of the latest move; may describe changing volatility.
availability: FMP daily close provisionally assigned to 17:00 New York; historical bar boundary is unresolved.

name: vol_20
intuition: Trailing volatility sets the scaled part of the label hurdle. This is not the full hurdle when the floor binds.
availability: FMP daily close provisionally assigned to 17:00 New York; historical bar boundary is unresolved.

name: vol_5_over_20
intuition: Recent volatility relative to its longer baseline.
availability: FMP daily close provisionally assigned to 17:00 New York; historical bar boundary is unresolved.

name: dist_ma20
intuition: Distance from a trailing price average; a possible stretch or trend state.
availability: FMP daily close provisionally assigned to 17:00 New York; historical bar boundary is unresolved.

name: dist_ma60
intuition: Distance from a trailing price average; a possible stretch or trend state.
availability: FMP daily close provisionally assigned to 17:00 New York; historical bar boundary is unresolved.

name: tokyo_reference_to_ny_close
intuition: Move since the Tokyo reference, including European trading; compares an interbank midpoint with a vendor composite close.
availability: BOJ 17:00 JST reference is assigned availability at 17:05 JST; combine its latest eligible value with the provisional FMP close.

name: weekend_in_window
formula_html: 𝟙{(t, t+1] spans a Saturday or Sunday}
intuition: Scheduled exposure to weekend news, without future market information.
availability: Constructed from the weekend calendar and six fixed holiday exclusions; known at the decision.

name: gap2y
intuition: Relative yield level as policy and carry context.
calendar: US and Tokyo legs aligned separately
availability: US Treasury leg: adopted 16:30 New York visibility; Japanese leg: 15:05 JST. Each leg keeps its own observation date.

name: gap2y_chg_1d
intuition: Change in the aligned rate differential as a policy-repricing hypothesis.
availability: Difference of already aligned legs over retained decision rows; both endpoint values must be eligible.

name: gap2y_chg_5d
intuition: Change in the aligned rate differential as a policy-repricing hypothesis.
availability: Difference of already aligned legs over retained decision rows; both endpoint values must be eligible.

name: us_slope_chg_5d
intuition: Change in the US curve as a policy and growth-expectations hypothesis.
availability: Compute on Treasury observations; align under the adopted 16:30 New York rule.

name: jp_slope_chg_5d
intuition: Change in the Japanese curve as a BOJ-expectations hypothesis.
availability: Compute on MOF observations; align under the adopted 15:05 JST rule.

name: banks_rel_5d
intuition: Banks relative to the Japanese market as a domestic-rate hypothesis.
availability: Adopted 15:35 JST visibility rule, after the Tokyo close (15:00 JST before 5 Nov 2024; 15:30 thereafter). Licensed values are not included here.

name: banks_rel_20d
intuition: Slower bank-sector relative performance.
availability: Adopted 15:35 JST visibility rule, after the Tokyo close (15:00 JST before 5 Nov 2024; 15:30 thereafter). Licensed values are not included here.

name: elec_rel_5d
intuition: Broad electronics relative performance; not a semiconductor or exporter basket.
availability: Adopted 15:35 JST visibility rule, after the Tokyo close (15:00 JST before 5 Nov 2024; 15:30 thereafter). Licensed values are not included here.

name: topix_5d
intuition: Broad Japanese equity risk context.
availability: Adopted 15:35 JST visibility rule, after the Tokyo close (15:00 JST before 5 Nov 2024; 15:30 thereafter). Licensed values are not included here.

name: vix
intuition: Level of implied equity volatility as a stress-state hypothesis.
availability: Adopted 16:20 New York visibility rule for VIX close; historical API delivery is not verified.

name: vix_chg_1d
intuition: Change in implied volatility; possible stress repricing.
availability: Adopted 16:20 New York visibility rule for VIX close; historical API delivery is not verified.

name: vix_chg_5d
intuition: Change in implied volatility; possible stress repricing.
availability: Adopted 16:20 New York visibility rule for VIX close; historical API delivery is not verified.

name: spy_1d
intuition: US equity performance as broad risk context.
availability: Adopted 16:05 New York visibility rule for adjusted ETF closes; historical API delivery is not verified.

name: spy_5d
intuition: US equity performance as broad risk context.
availability: Adopted 16:05 New York visibility rule for adjusted ETF closes; historical API delivery is not verified.

name: qqq_minus_spy_5d
intuition: Growth and technology leadership relative to the broad market.
availability: Adopted 16:05 New York visibility rule for adjusted ETF closes; historical API delivery is not verified.

name: qqq_minus_spy_20d
intuition: Slower growth-versus-market rotation.
availability: Adopted 16:05 New York visibility rule for adjusted ETF closes; historical API delivery is not verified.

name: smh_minus_qqq_5d
intuition: Semiconductor leadership relative to the technology-heavy index.
availability: Adopted 16:05 New York visibility rule for adjusted ETF closes; historical API delivery is not verified.

name: usd_basket_5d
intuition: Custom equal-weight dollar proxy excluding yen; not the official broad dollar index.
availability: FMP daily close provisionally assigned to 17:00 New York; historical bar boundary is unresolved. Returns use common endpoint dates; missing endpoint bars carry the prior close and are flagged.

name: yen_relative_5d
intuition: Relative performance under unit basket exposure; not a pure yen shock. Exactly collinear with its two components.
availability: FMP daily close provisionally assigned to 17:00 New York; historical bar boundary is unresolved. Linear selector stages use ret_5d and usd_basket_5d, omitting this redundant contrast.

name: wti_5d_lagged
intuition: Oil-price context for an energy importer; spot observations, not a futures trading return.
availability: Lag one source observation; the prior value becomes eligible at the next observation’s adopted 15:00 New York availability. Historical posting time remains unverified.

name: gld_5d
intuition: Gold as a monetary and risk-context hypothesis.
availability: Adopted 16:05 New York visibility rule for adjusted ETF closes; historical API delivery is not verified.

name: cftc_net
formula_html: q<sub>j</sub> = (LF longs<sub>j</sub> − LF shorts<sub>j</sub>) / open interest<sub>j</sub>
intuition: Leveraged-fund yen positioning; positive means net long yen.
availability: Latest report actually released by 15:35 New York on its release date; original 35-day cap measures age from the Tuesday observation, not release.

name: cftc_net_chg_4reports
intuition: Building or unwinding positioning across reports; four reports need not mean four weeks.
availability: Latest report actually released by 15:35 New York on its release date; original 35-day cap measures age from the Tuesday observation, not release.

name: cftc_release_age_days
intuition: Age of published information, distinct from the age of the positions it describes. The existing formula uses audit hours rounded to three decimals before dividing by 24.
availability: Latest report actually released by 15:35 New York on its release date; original 35-day cap measures age from the Tuesday observation, not release.

name: pos_z
intuition: Positioning relative to its own trailing report history.
availability: Latest report actually released by 15:35 New York on its release date; original 35-day cap measures age from the Tuesday observation, not release. Compute on reports before daily alignment, including the current report.

name: vol_z
intuition: Volatility relative to its own trailing decision history.
availability: Uses only trailing vol_20 values through t; no full-sample standardisation.

name: short_yen_stress
intuition: Observed net short-yen exposure during above-normal volatility; not total market carry leverage.
availability: Latest report actually released by 15:35 New York on its release date; original 35-day cap measures age from the Tuesday observation, not release. Combine with trailing vol_z only after alignment.

name: event_in_window
formula_html: 𝟙{a scheduled event falls in (17:00 t, 17:00 t+1]}
intuition: Scheduled-news exposure; contains no announcement result.
availability: FOMC 14:00 New York; BOJ MPM 12:00 JST convention; US CPI / Employment Situation 08:30 New York. Use schedules known at cutoff; exception flags identify unresolved announcement timing.

name: gapchg_x_vixchg
intuition: Conditional joint rate and volatility state as a policy/risk hypothesis.
availability: Compute trailing z-scores of already aligned inputs through t; no future centering or scaling.
